note: Each case runs in a fresh agent given the skills directory and a fixture; grade each assertion pass/fail from the transcript.

cases.prompt: Advisory only. Using the fe-architecture skill, where should a new 'order filters' feature live (status filter, date range, applied to the existing orders list, committed filters must survive reload)? Change no files.
